3558-5006-5686-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crookshank Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
3558-5006-5686-8170.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crookshank Kobolds spell. Then, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, creating a Blood token
Repeat.

240-5470-6791-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
240-5470-6791-8227.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

2178-2380-3967.easyPrerequisites:
Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
2178-2380-3967.description:
Activate Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, Repeat.

539-728-1202-3249.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-1202-3249.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1123-4247-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve both Bloodthrone Vampire abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
1123-4247-6972.notes: If Flayer of the Hatebound starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

339-677-728-4460.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2366-4452-6879-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
"[Type]" chosen with Rukarumel.
2366-4452-6879-8095.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the creature with changeling

4082-4640-5686--201.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature with changeling.
When that creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters, Kemba triggers, allowing you to attach Oathkeeper to that creature.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2511-6249-7920--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2511-6249-7920--5.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Tresserhorn's Lord trigger.
Resolve the Tresserhorn's Lord trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2034-4613-4679-7895--128.manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to activate the Licid's ability
2034-4613-4679-7895--128.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to activate the Licid's ability.
2034-4613-4679-7895--128.description:
Activate Little Bear using the Licid's ability by paying its activation cost, attaching Little Bear to Yenna and causing Little Bear to become an Aura.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Little Bear.
When the Little Bear token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Little Bear token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

654-880-7705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
654-880-7705.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor and Mole Man trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the land.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2012-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist
When Strangleroot Geist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist
When Strangleroot Geist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Strangleroot Geist enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
2012-5686-6972.notes: If Strangleroot Geist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

1605-3059-7408.description:
Cast Malignus by paying {3}{R}{R}. It'll enter with power equal to half the highest life total among your opponents, rounded up.
When Malignus enters, Champion of the Path triggers, causing Malignus to deal damage equal to its power doubled to each opponent due to Gratuitous Violence.
1605-3059-7408.notes: Malignus also makes the damage unpreventable due to its static effect. This combo should result in each opponent losing the game except in niche circumstances.

457-4478-5159-5491.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature with haste named Mishra's Warform, and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Map, adding {U}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it and a Map token for each Mishra's Warform and/or Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-4478-5159-5491.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

240-1251-2921-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

3693-4613-7289.description:
Activate Leonardo by using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Leonardo triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2079-2769-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-2769-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Hanweir Garrison as attackers.
Hanweir Garrison triggers, creating two creature tokens
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

5200-7203.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other creatures
5200-7203.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

2609-2757-5094-6071.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four permanent cards in your graveyard.
2609-2757-5094-6071.description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {3}{W}, creating a creature token and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping The Core.
Repeat.

1003-2173-5220-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

252-4871-5315.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

864-1987-4276-5913.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
864-1987-4276-5913.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Eternal Witness and Pinnacle Monk
When Eternal Witness and Pinnacle Monk enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
864-1987-4276-5913.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

2590-3698-5776.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2590-3698-5776.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as a Food due to Ygra, Experimental Confectioner's second ability and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, causing you to create a 1/1 Rat creature token.
When the Rat enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

3946-4426-5449.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

1558-1692-3263-3907.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Underworld Hermit.
1558-1692-3263-3907.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating at least one token copy of Underworld Hermit with haste.
When the Underworld Hermit token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Underworld Hermit token and the Squirrel tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

823-2438-2577-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
823-2438-2577-4740.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gravecrawler, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying 2 life.
Aetherflux Reservoir and Defiler of Flesh trigger.
Resolve the Aetherflux Reservoir trigger, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Resolve the Defiler of Flesh trigger, giving target creature +1/+1 and menace until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir's ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

3587-4090-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to you and a creature. The damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to Boros Reckoner instead due to Pariah.
Boros Reckoner triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to an applicable target.

1980-2989-4131-5261.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Burst of Energy without paying its mana cost, targeting Isochron Scepter.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, creating a copy of Burst of Energy, targeting Basalt Monolith.
Resolve both Burst of Energies, untapping Isochron Scepter and Basalt Monolith.
Repeat.

690-4658-5306.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
690-4658-5306.description:
Activate Disciple of Griselbrand by paying {1} and sacrificing Soul of Eternity, causing you to gain life equal to Soul of Eternity's toughness.
Sanguine Bond triggers, causing target opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.

799-1750-4861-5261.description:
Cast Karn's Temporal Sundering by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile Karn's Temporal Sundering.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Karn's Temporal Sundering into your graveyard from exile.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Karn's Temporal Sundering from your graveyard by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile Karn's Temporal Sundering.
Repeat from step 2.
